m1.typescript: m1 a tool call is run and its result sent back until the model ends its turn

e1.typescript: e1 parallel calls get one user message with every result in order

e2.typescript: e2 a failing unknown or malformed call becomes an error result and the loop goes on

e3.typescript: e3 the number of turns is bounded

e4.typescript: e4 refusal and truncation end the loop and a paused turn continues

e5.typescript: e5 tool choice is validated for the model and a forced choice applies to the first request only

e6.typescript: e6 results that are not text are sent as json text

wrong-result-per-message.defect: sends each tool result in a user message of its own

wrong-swallow-errors.defect: sends a failing tool's message without the error flag

wrong-extra-turn.defect: makes one model call more than the turn limit

wrong-ignore-stop-reason.defect: reports a refusal as a cut-off answer

wrong-forced-every-turn.defect: repeats a forced tool choice on every request, so the model can never finish

wrong-forced-on-new-models.defect: lets a forced tool choice through for models that reject it

wrong-repr-result.defect: sends the language's text form of an object instead of JSON
